England defeats Sri Lanka by 119 runs in T20 match

England secured a commanding 119-run victory over Sri Lanka in the first of three T20 internationals. The win was propelled by a significant batting performance from opener Jos Buttler and captain Harry Brook. Brook achieved a career-best score of 114 not out, reaching his century off just 42 balls. England set Sri Lanka a target, ultimately restricting them to a score that resulted in a decisive loss.
